kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أنكفئ (form VII)
# أَنْكَفِئُ (ʔankafiʔu) /ʔan.ka.fi.ʔu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْكَفَأَ (inkafaʔa)
# أَنْكَفِئَ (ʔankafiʔa) /ʔan.ka.fi.ʔa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْكَفَأَ (inkafaʔa)
# أَنْكَفِئْ (ʔankafiʔ) /ʔan.ka.fiʔ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْكَفَأَ (inkafaʔa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
